cisp.app.title: Common Information Service
cisp.app.tagline: U-space airspace information as published by the authority and the air navigation service provider
cisp.nav.label: Main navigation
cisp.locale.label: Language
cisp.applicability.applies: Applies at the chosen instant, as evaluated by the CIS.
cisp.applicability.not_applicable: Does not apply at the chosen instant, as evaluated by the CIS; drawn dimmed, not hidden.
cisp.applicability.unknown: The CIS could not evaluate this zone at the chosen instant (for example a daylight event it cannot place there and then). It is drawn in full and must be treated as possibly applying.
cisp.applicability.unstated: The CIS gave no verdict for this zone.
cisp.authority.name: Authority
cisp.banner.label: Data currency
cisp.banner.stale_snapshot: served from the CIS's held copy (database unreachable)
cisp.banner.publisher_never_heard: the publisher has never been heard from
cisp.feed.disconnected: Disconnected: the data shown may be out of date
cisp.list.undrawable: {count} served but not drawable (see the API).
cisp.list.circle: circle, not drawn on the map
cisp.panel.circle: Circle of radius {radius} m about its published centre. The API sends no outline for it, so the map does not draw it; it is listed here.
cisp.map.not_configured: The map's first view is not configured: {problem}.
cisp.ussps.title: Certified U-space service providers
cisp.list.circle_drawn: circle, outline drawn by the CIS
cisp.panel.circle_drawn: Circle of radius {radius} m about its published centre. The map draws the outline the CIS computed from it (64 points on the circle); the circle as published is what applies.
cisp.console.nav.label: Console navigation
cisp.console.read_only_notice: The console never edits airspace content. Zones, U-space airspace, restrictions and the USSP list are the authority's and the ANSP's; here you manage subscriptions, deliveries, accounts and re-notification only, and every action is recorded with your reason.
cisp.console.account.sign_out_failed: Sign-out failed; you are still signed in.
cisp.console.problem.unreachable: The API could not be reached; what is shown may be out of date.
cisp.console.problem.forbidden: Refused (403): your role does not allow this.
cisp.console.action.reason_too_long: The reason is longer than {max} characters.
cisp.console.login.intro: Sign in to the CIS console. An administrator's account asks for the code of its authenticator after the password.
cisp.console.login.locked: This account is locked after repeated failures.
cisp.console.login.locked_for: This account is locked after repeated failures. Try again in {minutes} min.
cisp.console.login.problem.invalid_crede: The username or the password is wrong.
cisp.console.login.problem.totp_reused: This code was used already; wait for the next one.
cisp.console.login.problem.mfa_required: This account needs an authenticator; ask an administrator to reset its MFA.
cisp.console.login.problem.challenge_inv: The sign-in step has expired; enter the password again.
cisp.console.login.problem.mfa_challenge: The sign-in step has expired; enter the password again.
cisp.console.login.problem.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts from this address.
cisp.console.login.problem.busy: The API is busy; try again shortly.
cisp.console.login.problem.console_unava: The console is not configured on this API.
cisp.console.login.problem.bff_unavailab: Sign-in is not configured on this web server.
cisp.console.status.label: Service status
cisp.console.status.publisher_never: Publisher {publisher} has never been heard from.
cisp.console.status.mtls_off: The ANSP's mTLS check is switched off (CISP_MTLS_MODE=off).
cisp.console.status.expiry_stale: The restriction expiry job has not run since {last} (bound {bound} s).
cisp.console.status.unavailable: The service status cannot be read.
cisp.console.overview.counters: Counters of this API instance since start
cisp.console.publications.not_served: Warnings, the signature key id and refused attempts are not served by the console API yet (docs/PLAN.md §15 Q44).
cisp.console.publications.republish_body: Every subscriber of {dataset} will receive a new change notification for version {version} and may pull it again. No content changes: no zone, restriction or list is edited, and no new version is made.
cisp.console.version.title: {dataset}, version {version}
cisp.console.diff.first_version: The first version of the dataset: everything in it was added.
cisp.console.diff.paths_truncated: The API listed only the first 200 paths of this feature; more differ.
cisp.console.diff.features_truncated: Only the first {count} features are listed; more changed in this version.
cisp.console.preview.title: Map preview
cisp.console.preview.note: Drawn from the public read of the current version; the outline of a circle is the CIS's drawing of it.
cisp.console.preview.unavailable: The public read failed; nothing is drawn.
cisp.console.preview.none_drawn: None of these features is in the current version; nothing is drawn.
cisp.console.preview.missing: Not drawn (not in the current version, or not drawable): {ids}
cisp.console.preview.not_current: This version is no longer current; the public read serves only the current one, so no map preview is drawn.
cisp.console.restrictions.read_only: Read only: the ANSP declares every state; the CIS only expires a restriction at its end.
cisp.console.restrictions.not_available: Restrictions are not available from this API (its restriction endpoints answer 404).
cisp.console.restrictions.ansp_stale: The ANSP is stale: silent since
cisp.console.restrictions.ansp_never: The ANSP is stale: it has never been heard from.
cisp.console.restrictions.expiry_age: The expiry job last ran {age} s ago (stale after {bound} s).
cisp.console.restrictions.expiry_stale: The expiry job is stale: it last ran {age} s ago (bound {bound} s). Restrictions past their end may still be listed as active.
cisp.console.restrictions.expiry_never: The expiry job has not run yet.
cisp.console.restrictions.refs_differ: The ANSP's heartbeat and the CIS differ. Declared active, not held: {unknown}. Held active, not declared: {missing}.
cisp.console.subscriptions.not_found: This subscription is not among the first {pages} pages of the list.
cisp.console.subscriptions.suspend_body: {client} will receive no change notification on this subscription until it is resumed; it must then be verified again. Its data is not touched.
cisp.console.subscriptions.resume_body: The subscription returns to pending verification: {client} receives a verification ping and, once it answers, change notifications again.
cisp.console.deliveries.title: Deliveries (last 24 h)
cisp.console.deliveries.log.unavailable: The attempt log could not be read: attempts are not shown.
cisp.console.deliveries.log.not_configur: The attempt log is not configured on this API: attempts are not shown.
cisp.console.deliveries.retry_body: The delivery is queued and due now: {client} will be sent this change notification again. Nothing else changes.
cisp.console.accounts.username_rule: Lower case, 3 to 64 of a-z 0-9 . _ - , starting with a letter or a digit.
cisp.console.accounts.once_warning: Shown once. Copy it now and hand it over securely: it cannot be shown again.
cisp.console.accounts.copy_failed: Copy failed; select the text instead.
cisp.console.accounts.set_role_body: {username} becomes {role}. Their open sessions are ended and they sign in again with the new role. The last active administrator cannot be demoted.
cisp.console.accounts.disable_body: {username} can no longer sign in, and their open sessions are ended. The last active administrator cannot be disabled.
cisp.console.accounts.reset_mfa_body: {username}'s authenticator stops working at once; a new enrolment URL is shown once, to hand over securely.
cisp.console.audit.since_invalid: The time cannot be read; give a full date and time.
